description: List the EVM contracts in the Contract Powers registry, with a one-line risk shape for each: is the code upgradeable, is the admin a single key (EOA) rather than a contract, how many powers are declared, and is it covered by a bug bounty. Use this to see what is already analysed before spending a lookup. Filters are optional and combine with AND.

single_key_admin.description: true = only contracts whose admin is a plain wallet (EOA), not a contract/multisig/timelock.

upgradeable.description: true = only contracts whose code can still be replaced.

name: list_watched_contracts
